prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot, head to toe, fine horizontal-striped crystal-and-wood body, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman in 1960s Italian film-star makeup — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large real pearl drop with a gold clip.

Physique: A towering tentpole USSBBW woman standing tall on long legs, never short or squat. Shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, massive rounded deltoids, a colossal chest projecting past the shoulders, a broad heavy torso with a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, her body finely striped, full-body

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow. Below this line, there is no bare skin anywhere on her body below this line — every part, without exception, is one of the materials described.

Her whole body below the collarbones is patterned in narrow horizontal stripes, alternating evenly between solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal crystal and carved dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque, running unbroken across shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both legs. At every seam where two pieces meet, one edge rises very slightly above its neighbour, casting a thin, crisp shadow — proving each piece is a truly separate object, not a flat pattern painted on one surface. Her left leg, all the way to the foot, is the last crystal stripe, ending in a matching carved sandal, the grain running unbroken through the ankle and every toe. Her right leg, all the way to the foot, is the last wood stripe, ending in a matching carved sandal, the grain running unbroken through the ankle and every toe.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep crimson red on one side and a bright cobalt blue on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so red light glances off one side and blue light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
